body.statement: Using the four-label bounded-test handle, construct an executable globally honest primal and a finite rational atomic dual for \(\mathfrak G_4\) at \(r=2\) whose fully outward-rounded endpoints satisfy \(U_{\varepsilon}-L_{\varepsilon}\le10^{-3}\), after charging every chart, seam, protected-neighborhood integral, tail, covariance, repair, and bit-cost term.
body.justification: This bounded instance is an adversarial falsification test for the feasibility of the global theorem and algorithm.
body.gap: The current rigorous interval is \([0.361100,0.813799]\); neither the literature nor the presolve provides a milliscale primal-dual gap.
body.consumer: A successful certificate validates the complete ledger before the method is deployed on the larger Job Corps label fan.
